```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given the system is running
    When a new Doctor with name "Dr. John", age "45", sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience "10", and speciality "Cardiology" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    And the Doctor's details should be displayed

  Scenario: Update Doctor details
    Given a Doctor with name "Dr. John" exists
    When the Doctor's name is updated to "Dr. Jane"
    And the Doctor's age is updated to "35"
    And the Doctor's sex is updated to "Female"
    And the Doctor's qualification is updated to "MD"
    And the Doctor's experience is updated to "15"
    Then the Doctor's details should be updated successfully
    And the Doctor's speciality should remain unchanged

  Scenario: Delete Doctor details
    Given a Doctor with name "Dr. John" exists and no pending Patient Consultation Requests
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then the Doctor's details should be deleted successfully

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist
    Given the system is running
    When a new Chemist with name "Chemist" and pincode "12345" is added
    Then the Chemist should be added successfully
    And the Chemist's details should be displayed

  Scenario: Update Chemist details
    Given a Chemist with name "Chemist" and pincode "12345" exists
    When the Chemist's name is updated to "New Chemist"
    Then the Chemist's details should be updated successfully
    And the Chemist's pincode should remain unchanged

  Scenario: Delete Chemist details
    Given a Chemist with name "Chemist" and pincode "12345" exists and no pending Prescriptions
    When the Chemist is deleted
    Then the Chemist's details should be deleted successfully

  Scenario: Add a new Lab
    Given the system is running
    When a new Lab with name "Lab" and pincode "12345" is added
    Then the Lab should be added successfully
    And the Lab's details should be displayed

  Scenario: Delete Lab details
    Given a Lab with name "Lab" and pincode "12345" exists and no pending Prescriptions
    When the Lab is deleted
    Then the Lab's details should be deleted successfully

  Scenario: Only one Lab can exist per pincode
    Given a Lab with name "Lab" and pincode "12345" exists
    When a new Lab with name "New Lab" and pincode "12345" is added
    Then the system should prevent the addition of the new Lab
    And an error message should be displayed
```
